content.text:
environment:
      MEMCACHE_SERVERS: memcached:11211
      # Don't specify the postgresql database here. This will get merged with an existing database.yml.
      DATABASE_URL: postgres://zammad:zammad@postgresql:5432
      REDIS_URL: redis://redis:6379
      # Performance / DX / tests tuning
--
    environment:
      - "ES_JAVA_OPTS=-Xms1024m -Xmx1024m"
      - discovery.type=single-node
      - xpack.security.enabled=false
      - http.cors.enabled=true
      - http.cors.allow-origin=/https:\/\/app.elasticvue.com/
--
    environment:
      POSTGRES_DB: zammad_development
      POSTGRES_USER: zammad
      POSTGRES_PASSWORD: zammad
    image: postgres:17.5-alpine
    restart: unless-stopped
    volumes:
      - postgresql-data:/var/lib/postgresql/data

=== database.yml ===
development:
  <<: *default
  database: zammad_development

# Warning: The database defined as "test" will be erased and
# re-generated from your development database when you run "rake".
# Do not set this db to the same as development or production.
test:
  <<: *default

observation.command: cd /workspace/.devcontainer/default && grep -A5 -E "POSTGRES|environment" compose.yaml | head -30; echo "=== database.yml ==="; grep -A8 "development:" /workspace/config/database.yml | head -12
